purpose: Ask for one supported Walmart endpoint that preserves the complete required store and fulfillment context.
message: Hi, I tested the update. Store drift improved, but the acceptance requirement is still not met. Direct Store 100 targeting is still unsupported, and the Store 100 / ZIP 72712 result still does not include explicit PICKUP proof. Please provide the exact supported endpoint and parameters that return these fields together in one response: Store 100, ZIP 72712, PICKUP, product ID, and local price. Please do not substitute a nearby store. If you provide a supported configuration, I will verify it with no more than three control requests before any larger collection.
